article.title: Antarctic, Greenland Sheets have melted enough since the ‘70s to cover U.S. in 5 feet of ice
article.author: Editor
article.content: “With every additional centimeter of sea-level rise,” the lead author noted, “about 2 to 3 million people are put at risk of annual coastal flooding.” The post Antarctic, Greenland Sheets have melted enough since the ‘70s to cover U.S. in 5 feet of ice appeared first on MR Online .
